hotels.title: Five-Star Mövenpick Central Wellington Escape with Onsite Restaurant, Indoor Pool & Sauna
hotels.description: Experience the best of Wellington in this stylish stay, nestled in the artistic Cuba Quarter, abundant with vibrant galleries, cafe culture and shopping boutiques. When you aren’t uncovering the city’s hidden gems, embark on a gastronomic journey at onsite Forge Restaurant & Bar, featuring New Zealand-inspired cuisine, with a side of panoramic city skyline. Unwind in the temperature-controlled indoor pool and detoxifying sauna, or perhaps sweat it out at the state-of-the-art fitness centre. Then, when the clock strikes chocolate hour, Mövenpick Hotel Wellington invites you to savour their iconic sweet sensations.
